message: The other night, we had a surprise blackout just as I was getting ready to binge my favorite show. Instead of panicking, I grabbed my trusty power bank and charged up my phone while I dug out a few solar-powered lanterns from the garage. We ended up playing board games by lantern light, and it turned into one of the best evenings! 🌟 Sometimes, a little prep can turn an unexpected moment into a cozy adventure. What’s your go-to trick for staying comfortable when the lights go out?
